message.content:
This is a gear pump that can also work as a hydraulic motor. The classification options are:

- Heading 8413: pumps for liquids. Subheading 8413.60 covers other rotary positive displacement pumps, and 8413.60.00 has statistical suffixes. HTSUS 8413.60.00 breaks down as 8413.60.20 (vane), 8413.60.40 (gear), 8413.60.60 (other).
- Heading 8412: hydraulic power engines and motors. 8412.29 covers other hydraulic engines and motors.

The unit is described as a pump when driven by a motor, and it can be reversed to act as a motor. Its principal function is a pump, a gear pump, so 8413.60 fits best.

Within 8413.60, the HTS lists 8413.60.20 as "Rotary positive displacement pumps: Other: Gear pumps" with a 10-digit stat suffix. In HTSUS, 8413.60.00 is divided like this:
- 8413.60.20: Vane pumps (statistical suffixes 8413.60.2010, 8413.60.2090)
- 8413.60.40: Gear pumps (statistical suffixes 8413.60.4010, 8413.60.4090)
- 8413.60.60: Other

I recall the gear pump line as 8413.60.40 with suffixes 10 (hydraulic fluid power) and 80 (other). Hydraulic fluid power pumps are likely 8413.60.4010? I am not sure of the exact suffix, and I think the real structure uses 8413.60.20 for gear pumps with suffixes 10 and 90. I will go with 8413.60.0000-style structure at the gear pump line, 8413.60.40.

I'll choose 8413.60.4010? Hmm, I'll settle on 8413.60.4000-type line with suffix 80 for other.
